summary: Cybin Inc. (d/b/a Helus Pharma) filed a Form 6-K and material change report announcing a US$50 million underwritten offering of 10,309,280 common shares at US$4.85 per share. Cantor Fitzgerald and Barclays acted as joint bookrunning managers. The offering closed on June 25, 2026. Proceeds will fund HLP003, HLP004, and HLP005 programs and general corporate purposes. This is a routine equity financing via a shelf prospectus, not a special situation. No takeover, activist, or restructuring event is present.
